0.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_1
0.description: You have the aspect of an adventurer. Let me guess─you stalk an elite mark.

3.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_A1_000_2
3.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (Stinging Sophie)

4.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_A1_000_3
4.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Melt)

5.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_A1_000_4
5.description: Tell me about the rank S elite mark. (Wulgaru)

7.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_10
7.description: I'm what some term a hunter<hex:021F0103>scholar. I not only pursue dangerous elite marks, but make a study of them.

8.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_11
8.description: It's well worth the effort, my young friend. Every elite mark is worth a goodly number of Allied Seals.

9.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_12
9.description: Still, their ferity cannot be underprized. Whatever your quarry, ask me your questions before you go in foolish pursuit.

10.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_13
10.description: Elite marks are ranked according to danger, you see. The most dangerous are rank S marks, and those carry a double risk: hard to find and hard to survive.

11.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_20
11.description: “Stinging Sophie. Fattened on the honeybees of Fullflower Comb, this giant hornet inspires both disgust and complacency.

12.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_21
12.description: “Contrary to what its excess of embonpoint suggests, this grotesquerie is agile enough to evade its would<hex:021F0103>be slayers, and instead give them a deadly stitch with its needle-sharp stinger.”

13.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_30
13.description: “Melt. Unfathomable in its concoction and unspeakable in its coagulation, this voidsent has its origins in a sylph's jest.”

14.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_31
14.description: The codex speaks the truth, my young friend. Gaze overlong at its sucking tumescence and something inside you will die...and it's put me off flummery for good.

15.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_40
15.description: “Wulgaru, the false tree. Not a few poachers have vanished after being bound overnight to this vampiric man<hex:021F0103>eater by unsuspecting Wood Wailers.

16.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_41
16.description: “Wulgaru is also drawn by noise and commotion, breaking its arboreal disguise to feast on the blood of its favorite prey: man.”

17.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00195_MOBHUNTERF1F2_000_42
17.description: In other words, go quietly and fight stealthily, adventurer. If a tree comes alive in the forest, you're not likely to notice until too late.
